import statistics

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
data = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate mean
mean = statistics.mean(data)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
absolute_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in data]
print(f"Absolute deviations: {absolute_deviations}")

# Calculate MAD
mad = statistics.mean(absolute_deviations)
print(f"MAD: {mad}")

# Round to thousandths place
mad_rounded = round(mad, 3)
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {mad_rounded}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
# Let me verify the data extraction and calculation more carefully

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 from the table (column 35)
# These are: Oct 2017, Nov 2017, Dec 2017, Jan 2018, Feb 2018, Mar 2018, Apr 2018, May 2018, June 2018, July 2018, Aug 2018, Sept 2018
data = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

print("Monthly net excise taxes (in millions):")
months = ['Oct 2017', 'Nov 2017', 'Dec 2017', 'Jan 2018', 'Feb 2018', 'Mar 2018', 'Apr 2018', 'May 2018', 'June 2018', 'July 2018', 'Aug 2018', 'Sept 2018']
for m, v in zip(months, data):
    print(f"{m}: {v}")

# Calculate mean
n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"\nSum: {sum(data)}")
print(f"Count: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
abs_devs = [abs(x - mean) for x in data]
print("\nAbsolute deviations from mean:")
for m, v in zip(months, abs_devs):
    print(f"{m}: {v:.2f}")

# Calculate MAD
mad = sum(abs_devs) / n
print(f"\nMAD (mean of absolute deviations): {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {round(mad, 3)}")
EOF
